title: Towards Balanced Alignment: Modal-Enhanced Semantic Modeling for Video Moment Retrieval
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Towards Balanced Alignment: Modal-Enhanced Semantic Modeling for Video Moment Retrieval Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) aims to retrieve temporal segments in untrimmed videos corresponding to a given language query by constructing cross-modal alignment strategies.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Experiments on three widely used benchmarks, including the out-of-distribution settings, show that the proposed framework achieves a new start-of-the-art performance with notable generalization ability (e.g., 4.42% and 7.69% average gains of R1@0.7 on Charades-STA and Charades-CG).

problems.name: Query Ambiguity, Invalid Queries, and Open-Set Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Therefore, in pursuit of better alignment, a natural idea is enhancing the video modality to filter out query-irrelevant semantics, and enhancing the text modality to capture more segment-relevant knowledge.
